To you, wherever you are,

I care about you more than words can explain. I fell in love through the little things — waiting for your messages, smiling at your name on my screen, wondering how your day went, and feeling happier simply because you were happy.

Sometimes I wish distance didn't exist. I wish I could be there to see your smile instead of imagining it, hear your laugh without a speaker between us, and hold your hand instead of wishing I could.

Because no matter how far apart we are, you've become my comfort, my happiness, and the person my heart always searches for.

Thank you for being the person who unknowingly became my peace, my comfort, and someone I think about far more than I probably should.

Yours always — Nihal
